plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 54.2% over 282 games (overall is 49.4%).
Stop queueing carry: 39.8% over 123 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 43% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Xeebs is at 429 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 74%. Past 32: 40%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 17 of 23 short games vs 6 of 15 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Vision is Xeebs's cheapest upgrade
insights.finding: 5.1 wards per game, 55% of the squad average. Wards cost nothing and they are being left in the shop.
insights.receipt: 3,176 placed + 220 cleared over 664 games; squad average 9.3/game

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 55% over 301 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 162 games on Khaimera at 53.2% — the field averages 52.5%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: A longest ranked killing spree of 17 (plus 3 more in casual modes — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Xeebs has receipts.
